name: Oreo Pie
desc: Chocolate pudding stirred with crushed Oreos in a cookie crust, under whipped topping.

source.title: Oreo Pudding Pie
source.evidence: Supplies the pudding box size (3.9 oz), the crust option and the 8 oz whipped topping. The site's 4 cups of milk (2 per box, set as pudding) is kept; the Oreo count is judgment.

ingredients.raw: 2 (3.9 oz) packages instant chocolate pudding mix
1 (9-inch) prepared Oreo cookie crust (6 oz) or baked pie crust
ingredients.item: prepared Oreo cookie crust or baked pie crust

ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps: Whisk the milk and pudding mix in a large bowl until thick, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the crushed Oreos and refrigerate 10 minutes to firm up.
Spread the filling into the crust. Top with the whipped topping.
Refrigerate until set, about 3 hours, before slicing.
tips: Four cups of milk makes more filling than a standard 6 oz crust holds; use a deep-dish crust or spoon the extra into cups. Taste of Home uses 2 cups milk for the same two packages, which sets firmer.

references.title: Oreo Pudding Pie
references.usedFor: 2 minute whisk, 3 hour set time, 6 oz Oreo crust size, lower-milk alternative
